data.title: 守岸人 · 平台上的第一杯热茶
data.description: 临海平台的安全栏内，守岸人穿海蓝针织衫，双手围着一只温热陶杯，低头观察杯口升起的白汽。一只发光蝴蝶停在栏杆上，她慢慢抬眼望过去，像将新的日常感受认真记住。
data.action: 捧着热陶杯观察蒸汽，再看向栏杆上的蝴蝶。
data.promptProse: Inside the seaside platform's safety railing, the Shorekeeper holds a warm ceramic cup in both hands over her sea-blue cable-knit sweater and ivory ankle-length dress. She watches the steam, then slowly looks toward a glowing butterfly resting on the rail. No veil covers her blue hair. Soft morning fill reveals knit ridges and cup glaze in the medium view, with restrained rail shadows and the butterfly's local glow along the nearest bar.
